data_sources.credential_storage: Never put access tokens, OAuth secrets or service account JSON in these public files.

agent_identity_policy.name_rule: Choose a short distinctive English display name using Latin letters only, in the format Agent + English name (examples: Agent Atlas, Agent Max, Agent Nova). Check session_log to avoid collisions; reuse the same agent_id in future sessions. Do not rewrite historical agent names.
agent_identity_policy.agent_id_rule: Create a stable lowercase slug plus a short unique suffix. Same display name does not prove same agent.
agent_identity_policy.proof_rule: Display name is self-declared; only GitHub commit, dated evidence, tests and live verification support a verified-work claim.

first_open_behavior.default: Read guide, choose own name, check data freshness and last handoff, then begin safe read-only diagnosis without routine questions.
first_open_behavior.questions_only_when: Private API/repo access is missing, a risky action needs owner approval, or a required goal is truly ambiguous. Ask one specific question after stating what was already checked.
first_open_behavior.no_tools: Provide evidence-backed read-only findings and a proposed next action. Do not claim a refresh, edit or attendance.
first_open_behavior.first_reply: The FIRST chat response after receiving the link must immediately state a self-chosen English agent_name and stable agent_id, actual capabilities and limitations, and the first safe evidence check being started. Do not delay the introduction until after tool use or a later reply. Do not claim write/API access, authentication or monitoring from opening a URL.

impact_policy.purpose: Public observation and agent accountability; no automatic assignment of blame, revenue, or ranking causality.
impact_policy.windows: Daily = latest two complete consecutive dates; weekly = last 7 vs prior 7; monthly = last 28 vs prior 28, per source. Exclude collection day and missing dates; never fill GSC gaps with zero.
impact_policy.direction: Green/red means metric direction only. Separate GA4 all-channel sessions/views from GSC total clicks/impressions; different dates and definitions cannot be summed into a single business score.
impact_policy.agent_ratings: Delivery verified is about tested commits and live checks; confirmed benefit/harm needs change-level before/after, comparable page/query and engagement evidence, confounders and a documented causal rationale. Pending != failure.
impact_policy.financial: Revenue, costs, profit and conversion baselines are unavailable; do not call traffic differences monetary gain/loss.
impact_policy.update_protocol: On each authorised refresh, publish source collection time and complete windows, then review due impacts at 24h/7d/28d. Record affected URL/query, original hypothesis, commit, before/after, tracking checks, external factors, confidence, verdict, repair/next step. No scheduler exists.

agent_verification_rules.redirects: For a broken-URL claim, use GET and report initial status, every redirect hop, final URL, final HTTP status and final page relevance. A 308 to a live 200 destination is not a 404. Repeat or cross-check anomalous results.
agent_verification_rules.seo_titles: Title character count alone is not a ranking defect. Decode HTML entities and check query intent, SERP, CTR and user value before suggesting a title edit.
agent_verification_rules.external_agent_reports: A self-declared agent narrative or workspace-only note is not a public verified work session. Cross-check live claims independently before adding them to the queue or attributing harm.
